He continually ran a high fever and from time to time spoke deliriously. Even so, Mitsuhide paid little heed to it. paragraphs.source_en: Mitsuhide himself was commander-in-chief of the main force, which also included Akechi Jūrōzaemon, Araki Yamashiro-no-kami, Araki Tomonojō, Suwa Hida-no-kami, Saitō Kurano-suke, Okuda Kunai, Mimaki Sanzaemon, and more than thirty-two hundred others.
